summary: OS Therapies filed an 8-K disclosing a settlement and mutual release with Leonite Fund I, LP on July 31, 2026, following an earlier secured convertible note private placement. The company agreed to pay $1.9 million in cash and issue 500,000 shares of common stock by August 7, 2026, to fully satisfy all outstanding amounts under the Leonite Note and related agreements. This settlement resolves a financial obligation involving potential default or restructuring of the secured financing. The original note had an up to $10 million principal amount, with an initial tranche of $1.6 million funded in July 2026. The settlement implies a negotiated resolution of the debt, with shares and cash as consideration. Watch for completion of the payment and share issuance, and any further restructuring or financing actions.
